name: Geostationary Imager Observation Request Builder Nodes
description: Request-builder flow nodes for imager observations from public sources, no credentials: GOES-East/West ABI (NOAA noaa-goes19/18 NetCDF4), Himawari-9 AHI (NOAA noaa-himawari9: ISatSS tiles and the L2 cloud HDF5 files) and EUMETSAT's public view service (Meteosat-12 FCI, Meteosat-9 SEVIRI IODC, Metop-B/C AVHRR, WMS). plan turns a timer tick into, per satellite, the frame hours of the window not yet landed: one S3 ListObjectsV2 request per product folder (with its list job), or a view work job straight to the parser; select_files turns the listings into one parser work job per file or band of tiles; note takes the parser's notices; publish_request turns a storage-ingest result plus the parser's ingest meta into the field's landed mark (a one-byte GET of the source object under ?sdn-ingest=landed, so the node's HTTP validator ledger remembers it across restarts) and, when imager_publish_url is set, the dataset-publication POST. Node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig: imager_live_access, imager_satellites, imager_fields, imager_widths, imager_backfill_hours (72), imager_view_backfill_hours (0), imager_frame_time, imager_lag_minutes[_<satellite>], imager_max_part_bytes, timeouts, imager_publish_url. No credentials: capabilities none.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns its control frames into request/job frames in one pass. The module keeps a small state between invocations: the landed set (satellite|frame|field, the retention window's size), the view frames tried, and plan's and select_files's queues of pending frames, handed out kPlanBatch per invocation as the compiled runtime resumes the yielded node; no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: Timer tick -> per satellite, the frame hours of the window not yet landed (ledger satellites: imager_backfill_hours; view satellites: the newest hour, imager_view_backfill_hours and frames reported missing): one S3 ListObjectsV2 GET per product folder with its list job, or a view work job to the parser; 32 frames per invocation, the rest yielded as backlog. When nothing is left: the node's unchanged notice on status. One tick per invocation (a surplus is refused as batched-input-frames).

wildcardJustification.detail: Cron timer tick frame produced by the flow runtime and consumed inside this flow only; it carries no payload of its own, so there is no SDS record to name.
hostcap/http-request request descriptor ({method,url,headers,timeoutMs,responseWire}) produced and consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host http.request op, not by SDS.

outputPorts.description: One listing request per (satellite, product folder).

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-listing job (satellite, sensor, bucket, prefix, frame time, fields, widths) consumed by select_files inside the same flow; never persisted.

outputPorts.description: One list job per listing request, in the same order.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-file work job for the imager-observation-parser inside the same flow (kind abi | ahi-tiles | ahi-h5 | view; satellite attribution, frame time, widths, the object keys and sizes or the view frame, the fields); never persisted.

outputPorts.description: One parser work job per file, band of tiles or view frame.

wildcardJustification.detail: Cycle status ({skipped:<reason>} or {missing:[...]}) reported to the flow egress; diagnostics, never persisted as a record.

outputPorts.description: Why a cycle emitted nothing, or which files the listings lacked.

methods.description: Listing responses + list jobs (paired by position) -> one parser work job per file: ABI the hour's first full-disk scan of each field (scan stamp _s<YYYY><DDD><HH>0, band -M<n>C<band>_ for imagery), AHI a band's ISatSS tiles as one job and each L2 cloud product file as one job naming the fields read from it. 32 per invocation, the rest yielded. Files not (yet) published and failed listings are reported on status as the node's unchanged notice; a count mismatch is refused.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-listing job emitted by plan inside the same flow; never persisted.

methods.description: The parser's notices ({satellite, frame_time_ms, field, state}: landed - its landed-mark probe answered 304; missing - a view frame the service did not have yet) into the module's landed set and view retry set. No outputs.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-field notice from the imager-observation-parser inside the same flow (landed mark found, view frame missing); never persisted.

methods.description: A storage-ingest result + the parser's ingest meta -> the field landed in the module's set, its landed mark (a one-byte GET the node's HTTP validator ledger remembers: the parser's probe of the same URL is then answered 304, also after a restart), and one dataset-publication POST ({schema, providerId, sourceName, batchId}) to imager_publish_url when set. A result that stored nothing marks nothing. Results pair with metas by batch id (a meta whose ingest failed is left behind).

wildcardJustification.detail: hostcap/storage-ingest result JSON (schema, inserted, batch_id) consumed inside this flow.
storage.ingest_with_source meta emitted by the parser inside this flow.
hostcap/http-request request descriptor ({method,url,headers,timeoutMs,responseWire}) produced and consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by the host http.request op, not by SDS.

outputPorts.description: The field's landed mark: a one-byte GET (If-Modified-Since at the epoch, Range bytes=0-0) of the source object under ?sdn-ingest=landed&field=<field>.
